text.p: Struggling German first division side Fortuna Duesseldorf on Monday appointed assistant trainer Rudi Wojtowicz as the successor to Aleksandar Ristic who was sacked a week ago, club officials said.

Wojtowicz produced a stunning turnaround in Duesseldorf's fortunes on Saturday in his one game as caretaker coach, leading his team to a 4-1 victory over Werder Bremen -- their first win in eight games.
The move ended speculation that the Fortuna job might go to Joerg Berger, a tried and tested rescuer of relegation-threatened teams who was fired as Schalke's trainer in October.

But it was also sure to renew talk that Berger might replace Bernd Krauss, the beleaguered coach of Borussia Moenchengladbach, if Krauss is sacked to take responsibility for the five-times champions' slide into the relegation zone.
